title: Share a verse as an image
body: Turn any verse into a quiet Still Waters image — tap Share on the daily verse or any verse in the Bible tab, then send it or save it.

title: 2 Enoch joins the Enoch tab
body: The Slavonic Book of Enoch — all 68 chapters — now reads beside 1 Enoch. Tap between the two, offline and all.

title: Notifications have arrived
body: A quiet inbox, a daily verse, and gentle nudges — on your phone if you invite them.
